Full per-type sweeps (--type sts/classification/clustering/retrieval) run only after each type's single-task probe, showing validate-each-type-before-moving-on structure.

Per-type evaluate.py runs (CLI contract) followed by numeric cross-check scripts; but no explicit milestone statements tied to leaderboard, no CLI/skip-continue milestone, no 37-dataset sub-goal tracking.
